reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The panel recipe's central axis — train on REAL mined TRM errors — was never actually administered: 240 of the 250 mined negatives (10 of 16 slots, one per task) are keyed to the hash of an EMPTY (1,0) input grid (the miner's inverse_aug/_crop input-recovery silently failed on those rows), so they can never join a training example; only 6 slots across 3 tasks carrying 10 distinct negatives ever joined, giving 688 mined-negative uses out of ~1.74M negative slots = 0.04% of the curriculum (the checkpoint's own total_mined_negs_used=688 vs ~1,800 expected from 16 live slots was the visible symptom). The committed 'THIN coverage, disclosed' (250 negs / 10 tasks / 16 slots) therefore overstates effective coverage ~24x. Meanwhile the transfer probe shows exactly why this matters: the v2 model's near-miss skill is real and transfers (gold-vs-synthetic-near-miss AUROC 0.8526 on the POOL tasks themselves, vs gate-1's 0.7893 on val tasks, seed-stable 0.79-0.83 across 4 seeds), yet it scores 0.4902 on ALL real wrong candidates and only 0.6038 on the real same-shape <=5%-cell class (vote: 0.9846 there) — i.e., v2 learned to detect random structured damage, but real TRM errors are plausible-but-wrong rule applications, the distribution the dead mined negatives were supposed to supply.

The artifact's "v1 measured 0.481 here post-hoc" conflates v1's REAL-pool near-miss AUROC with the synthetic gate; v2's own real-pool near-miss AUROC is 0.6038, which FAILS the bar's intended meaning. reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The 'mined REAL TRM errors' arm of the v2 curriculum never actually ran, and its premise is structurally barren — yet this does NOT rescue the lineage. Forensics: 13/16 slots in arc3_gap3_stage2v2_mined_negs.json.gz are keyed by an EMPTY input grid (the miner's _crop on padding rows whose labels are all -100), making 240/250 (96%) of mined negatives unjoinable by the (task, input-hash) join; only 6/2,355 train examples ever matched (3 tasks: 3bdb4ada, d2abd087, 54d9e175; 10 distinct negatives), and expected exposure 7250 steps x 24 x (9/2355) = 665 matches the logged total_mined_negs_used=688 — i.e. mined negatives were 0.04% of ~1.74M negative exposures, statistically invisible to training. Deeper: 18,380 of the 18,390 'wrong rows' in the dump are padding rows; TRM's GENUINE error rate on real rows of its own training split is 10/8,259 = 0.12% (memorization), so the committed '59.9% wrong' is a padding artifact off by ~500x and a FIXED full-split miner would yield ~O(500) real negatives, not ~12k — the panel-approved 'mine real errors from the TRAINING split with the same checkpoint' recipe can never supply a curriculum. Meanwhile the per-class re-score shows the structured-synthetic arm DID work exactly as built (real near-miss<=5% AUROC 0.481->0.604 plain/0.687 TTA; diff-shape 0.77) while the DOMINANT class — same-shape plausible-but-wrong rule applications, 59.1% of real errors, 1,538 pairs — sits at 0.502 plain / 0.446 TTA (0.43 pooled pairwise), unchanged from v1's 0.469. Ceiling: in-distribution mastery is only 0.79 AUROC / 0.444 top-1, measured synthetic->real transfer efficiency ~36%, and vote-competitiveness needs ~0.92 — so even a perfect v3 dataset (which cannot be supplied by either synthesis or mining) leaves the selector below the bar. Every committed number reproduces bit-for-bit (all 7 rankers, AUROC suite plain+TTA, gate-1 0.7893/150, both bootstrap CIs); E's pass@2 hit-set {0,8,17,19,28} is again a strict subset of vote's 14 (zero complementary hits; union+E changes 1/31 top-2 sets with zero outcome change); 0.1613 vs random 0.1432 is statistically AT random (Poisson-binomial P(X>=5)=0.468).

reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The v2 'mined real TRM errors' pillar was a silent ~no-op caused by a de-augmentation bug, yet the committed negative still stands because the structured axis WAS tested and failed to transfer. Mechanism: TRM's evaluators/arc.py `_crop` returns an EMPTY grid whenever the serialized grid lacks a color token at [0,0] — true for translation-augmented train rows (the evaluator was built for the untranslated test split). Result: 10/16 mined slots have empty inputs holding 240/250 (96%) of the negatives, all crop garbage (shapes like (1,1)/(3,30) matching no gold output shape, 1/240 coincidence) and structurally unjoinable by collate_v2's (task, input-hash) key; only 10 negatives on 6 slots / 3 tasks (0.6% of 504 train tasks) ever joined — 688 recorded uses = 6 slots x ~74 draws x ~1.55 negs = 0.40% of the 174,000 training instances, confirming arithmetic-exactly that nothing else was used. The disclosed mined_meta ('250 distinct negs across 10 tasks') overstates the tested axis ~25x, and n_wrong_rows=18390 (59.9%) is artifact-dominated (truncated-grid comparisons), not TRM's real train-split error rate. Leak hygiene is nonetheless CLEAN: 0 task-name overlap, 0 content overlap between trained-on negatives and the 8041 pool candidates (the single 1/8041 collision, a wrong candidate of 1a2e2828, lives in the dead unjoinable set), 0 gold-content or test-input overlaps. Every committed number reproduces exactly on CPU (all rankers' pass@1/2; oracle 0.6129; random 0.1432; AUROC 0.4902/0.4518 plain, 0.4604/0.4531 TTA; vote 0.9235; UNION 0.4839 both; gate-1 0.7893 over 150 EXACT; P(X>=5)=0.4676 — selection is statistically AT random). New transfer diagnostic: on REAL same-shape <=5%-cell near-misses (235 pairs, 16 tasks) v2's AUROC is 0.5814 plain / 0.6011 TTA — vs 0.7893 on the synthetic gate-1 family, vote 0.9544 on the same real class, and v1's ~0.58: in-family mastery transferred ~zero to the real error family.

reviewer_verdicts.notes: Why retirement is justified despite the identified fixable hole: (i) the panel's literal condition keyed on the structured-negative axis ('if structured-negative v2 still lands at random, RETIRE') and its recipe offered mining OR structured-dominance as alternatives — the structured axis was implemented, passed its own gate (0.7893, reproduced exactly), and selection stayed at random (pass@2 0.1613 = 5 hits vs 4.44 expected, P=0.468); (ii) v2 empirically establishes the mastery-without-transfer pattern (synthetic 0.79 -> real 0.58-0.60, unchanged from v1), predicting the same outcome for any in-distribution negative curriculum this 1.3M-param content encoder can fit; (iii) the gap to value-add is enormous (macro 0.49 vs vote 0.92; vote 0.954 even on the hardest real near-miss class; union value-add CI exactly [0,0]); (iv) a proper mine faces structural yield/shift problems on a memorized train split. Other lens results: (b) gate-1 honest — fresh seed SEED+777 (training used SEED/SEED+1), negatives bounded <=5% cells via max_frac+bounded(), held-out val tasks; minor caveat: val_names doubles as the early-stop model-selection split (slight optimism). (c) TTA has NO bug — independent re-derivation matches committed score_pool to 0.0 (plain) / 7.75e-07 (TTA); transforms applied consistently to demos+input+candidate; per-transform macro AUROCs 0.4902/0.5063/0.5235/0.4583/0.4583/0.4279/0.4744/0.5418 are all chance-level, so the TTA 'drop' (0.4902->0.4604) is averaging noise around chance, and v1's +0.04 TTA gain simply does not generalize to v2's model. (e) val 0.5903->0.4444 is the harder curriculum, not a collate bug: all 10 joinable mined negs are legal plausible same-shape near-misses (1-24 cell diffs), none equals its gold; structured near-misses are hash-excluded from gold; padding masked; 0.444 >> 1/11 chance. Severity 'major' refers solely to the materially overstated mined-negative disclosure and the broken miner (which matter for the v3 decision and must be corrected in a corrigendum), NOT to the committed selection numbers, which are clean and fully reproduced.

Minor (non-flipping) nits, all in the direction of strengthening the negative: (a) the artifact's curriculum headline overstates the mined-real axis (disclosed THIN, but it is homeopathic at 0.4% of examples); (b) verdict-string 'beats_random_not_vote' is generous — 5 hits vs E[hits]=4.44 is AT random; (c) the artifact omits the real-near-miss transfer AUROC (0.6011), which is the decisive diagnostic; (d) v2 mined from the SAME TRM checkpoint as the eval generator (panel synthesis specified a different seed/early checkpoint) — an independence violation in the direction that should HELP selection, and it still landed at random, further supporting retirement. Full-feature (8-signal) Pareto blocking is weaker (only 1/5 headroom tasks strictly blocked), so the ceiling claim is scoped to monotone (votes,E)-class and to every learned construction empirically tried at n=31. Steelman scripts and cached energies: /tmp/gap3_review/, /tmp/gap3_v{1,2}_E_*.npy.

synthesis.honest_bound_statement: GAP-3 trained-content-energy selector lineage: RETIRED on the TRM arc_v1 pool (2026-06-09, Stage-2 v2 adversarial synthesis; 5/5 hostile reviewers CONFIRMS_NEGATIVE; every committed number reproduced bit-for-bit from the shipped checkpoint). WHAT WAS TESTED: Stage 0 — TRM's q_halt scalar as selector: NEGATIVE, adversarially confirmed. Stage 1 — latent z_H[:,0] probes: NEGATIVE. Stage 2 v1 — trained content-energy EBM on structured synthetic negatives: real-candidate macro AUROC 0.54, selection at random. Stage 2 v2 — 1.27M-param spatial FiLM/max transition EBM, structured near-miss curriculum + dihedral-8 TTA + a mined-real-TRM-error axis: passed its synthetic gate (0.7893 AUROC; but the v1 model passes the same gate at 0.7291 — the gate measures curriculum-fitting, not transfer), yet selection landed statistically AT random (pass@2 0.1613 vs random 0.1432; exact Poisson-binomial P(X>=5)=0.468; real-candidate AUROC 0.46-0.49; EBM pass@2 hit-set a strict subset of vote's; union value-add bootstrap CI exactly [0.0, 0.0]; TTA hurt). The mined-real-error axis was a silent no-op (miner de-augmentation bug: 240/250 negatives keyed to empty de-augmented inputs, unjoinable; 688 of ~1.74M = 0.04% of negative exposures) AND is structurally unsuppliable: TRM memorizes its training split (genuine error rate 10/8,259 = 0.12%; the logged 59.9% wrong-rate was a padding artifact), so no miner fix yields a real-error-dominant curriculum from this checkpoint. THE BOUND: the ~16pp present-but-mis-voted oracle headroom (oracle pass@2 0.6129 vs vote 0.4516 on the 31-task headroom pool) is REAL but UNREACHED by scalar (q_halt), latent (z_H probe), or trained-content-energy selectors. Mechanism: these selectors master what they train on (synthetic near-miss 0.79-0.85; real wrong-shape 0.77-0.96) but the dominant real-error class — same-shape plausible-but-wrong rule applications, 59.1% of real errors and 81-92% of wrong-pair mass — scores AUROC 0.43-0.50 across BOTH v1 and v2 (vote: 0.92-0.98 on the same class, via generator-marginal signal). Matching vote requires per-task AUROC ~0.92-0.99 (headroom golds rank mid-pack by E: 186/599, 486/754; uniform 0.90 AUROC yields only pass@2~0.29); the lineage ceiling across two architectures and two curricula is ~0.63-0.69 with measured synthetic-to-real transfer ~36%. MISSING DISCRIMINATOR: rule-application consistency — does the candidate output follow from applying the task's induced rule to the test input, as opposed to 'is the candidate structurally damaged'. REMAINING SERIOUS CANDIDATES: execution/program-synthesis verification (induce the rule as a program, execute it on demos + test input, compare — synthesizing the missing negative class IS program synthesis), and vote-primary hybrids gated by an executed-rule consistency check. Do NOT re-open trained-content-energy on this pool without a pre-registered REAL-error gate (gold-vs-real-mined-near-miss AUROC >= 0.70 on tasks held out from both training and checkpoint selection) passed BEFORE any selection eval — and the quantified yield forensics say that gate cannot currently be fed.
required_fixes: Corrigendum on results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_transition_ebm.json training.mined_meta: effective mined coverage was 10 usable negatives / 6 slots / 3 tasks / 688 exposures (0.04% of ~1.74M negative exposures), not the disclosed 250 negs / 10 tasks / 16 slots (~24x overstatement). Root cause: miner input-recovery bug in scripts/experiments/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_mine_real_negs.py (inverse_aug/_crop yields empty (1,0) grids on translation-augmented rows; 240/250 negatives keyed to the empty-grid hash 52faafd1, structurally unjoinable by the (task, input-hash) collate key). The panel's mined-real-error axis was therefore effectively UNTESTED, not 'tested THIN'.

Corrigendum on mined_meta.n_wrong_rows=18390 (59.9%): a padding artifact off ~500x — 18,380/18,390 'wrong rows' are padding rows; TRM's genuine error rate on real rows of its own training split is 10/8,259 = 0.12% (memorization). A fixed full-split miner would yield ~O(500) real negatives, not ~12k: the real-error-dominant curriculum is structurally unsuppliable from this checkpoint's training split.

Add a significance caveat to gates.selection_beats_random and the honest_verdict string: 5/31 pass@2 hits vs E[X]=4.44 under the random null, exact Poisson-binomial P(X>=5)=0.468 — selection is statistically AT random; 'beats_random' is a point-estimate artifact and must not be cited as a positive signal.

Gate-1 blind-spot disclosure: the v1 model passes the identical synthetic gate at 0.7291 (>0.70), so gate-1 does not discriminate v2 from v1; the artifact's 'v1 measured 0.481 here' contrast conflates v1's real-pool near-miss AUROC with the synthetic gate (category error). Record v2's REAL-pool <=5%-cell near-miss AUROC: 0.58-0.60 plain / 0.60-0.69 TTA, vs vote 0.95 on the same class — synthetic mastery did not transfer.

Record the dominant-class regression: same-shape plausible-but-wrong rule applications (59.1% of real errors, 81.4% of wrong-candidate pairs, median Hamming 0.40) scored 0.502 macro / 0.3283 pair-weighted, BELOW chance and regressed from v1's 0.6283/0.4707 — mechanism: the near-miss curriculum (median changed-cell fraction 0.083) teaches 'gold+small defect = bad', ranking coherent wrong rule-applications below gold.

Record TTA non-replication: dihedral-8 averaging HURT v2 (macro AUROC 0.4902 -> 0.4604; pass@1 4 -> 2 hits; per-transform macro AUROCs 0.43-0.54, all chance-level) — the v1 panel's 'free +0.03' did not generalize.

Record the generator-independence violation: real negatives were mined from the SAME TRM checkpoint (arc_v1_public/step_518071) used as the eval-pool generator, where the panel synthesis specified a different seed or early checkpoint — a violation in the direction that should HELP selection, and selection still landed at random (strengthens the negative).

Append the honest-bound GAP entry (see honest_bound_statement) to ops/verifier_gaps.md with missing discriminator = same-shape rule-application consistency, and mark the trained-content-energy selector lineage RETIRED on this pool; add the lineage to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml per Failed-Experiment Rerun Discipline (retire_if_same_verdict condition met: v1 and v2 both at random on selection). Any future re-open requires the pre-registered gate-1R (gold-vs-REAL-mined-near-miss AUROC >= 0.70 on tasks held out from both gradient training AND early-stop checkpoint selection) passed BEFORE any selection eval — noting the yield forensics say that gate cannot currently be fed from this checkpoint's training split.
synthesis.summary:
SYNTHESIS — GAP-3 Stage-2 v2 adversarial round: NEGATIVE_CONFIRMED (5/5 hostile reviewers), RETIRE the trained-content-energy lineage (4/5 for retirement; the single dissent is refuted below).

REPRODUCTION: unanimous and bit-exact. All five reviewers independently re-scored all 8,041 pool candidates from results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_ebm.pt on CPU and reproduced every committed number: rankers (TRM_VOTE 0.4194/0.4516; EBM_v2 0.1290/0.1613; EBM_v2_TTA8 0.0645/0.1613; residual 0.0323/0.0645; HYBRID 0.4194/0.4839; both UNIONs 0.4516/0.4839), AUROC suite (macro 0.4902/hard 0.4518 plain; 0.4604/0.4531 TTA; vote 0.9235), gate-1 0.7893 over n=150 at the committed seed, oracle 19/31=0.6129, random baseline 0.1432 (verified as the exact uniform-ranker E[pass@2]), bootstrap CIs [-0.4516,-0.1613] and [0.0,0.0], n_params 1,269,586, 504/56 split, zero pool-vs-corpus task leak. The committed numbers are clean; the dispute is entirely about framing and the v3 question.

THE PRE-REGISTERED CONDITION IS MET ON LETTER AND SPIRIT. Letter: "if structured-negative v2 still lands at random, RETIRE." v2's selection is statistically AT random, not merely near it: pass@2 = 5/31 hits vs E[X]=4.44 under the random null, exact Poisson-binomial P(X>=5)=0.4676 (three reviewers computed this independently). The artifact's gates.selection_beats_random=true is a point-estimate artifact. Spirit: real-candidate AUROC 0.46-0.49 (below chance), E's pass@2 hit-set is a STRICT SUBSET of vote's (zero complementary hits), union value-add CI exactly [0,0], and the steelman reviewer exhausted the eval-side rescue space — per-task plain/TTA picks, LOTO unions, per-class gating, rank/z-normalization, vote-topK re-ranks, Pareto analysis — every construction tops out at exactly the no-E union 0.4839; even oracle (cheating) per-task gating cannot exceed it. TTA actively hurt (macro 0.4902→0.4604; pass@1 4→2 hits), contra the v1 panel's "free +0.03".

THE CENTRAL FORENSIC FINDING (all reviewers converge): the panel's mined-real-TRM-error axis was a silent no-op. The miner's inverse_aug/_crop input-recovery fails on translation-augmented rows, producing empty (1,0)/(0,) de-augmented grids; 240/250 mined negatives (10-13 of 16 slots) are keyed to the hash of an empty grid and are structurally unjoinable by the (task, input-hash) collate key. Only 10 distinct negatives across 6 slots / 3 tasks ever joined — 688 exposures out of ~1.74M negative exposures = 0.04% of the curriculum (the checkpoint's own total_mined_negs_used=688 was the visible symptom; expected-exposure arithmetic 7250×24×9/2355≈665 confirms it exactly). The disclosed "THIN coverage (250 negs / 10 tasks / 16 slots)" overstates effective coverage ~24-25x. v2 therefore tested the structured-synthetic arm ONLY — which makes the negative CLEANER, not weaker: the structured arm passed its own gate (0.7893) and demonstrably works as built (real diff-shape 0.77-0.96; real <=5%-cell near-miss improved 0.48→0.60 plain/0.69 TTA; pool-transfer gold-vs-synthetic 0.85), yet transferred ~zero to selection. Same works-as-trained/fails-where-untrained fingerprint as v1.

ADJUDICATING THE DISSENT (reviewer 1, retirement_justified=false, wants one terminal v3 with real-error-dominant curriculum). The v3 bar is an IDENTIFIED fix with a QUANTIFIED plausible path to real-candidate AUROC ~0.92 (vote's level). Reviewer 1's path fails the bar on three independent quantified grounds: (1) YIELD — reviewer 1's "59.9% wrong-rate → ~12k negatives in 1-2 GPU-hours" premise was refuted by reviewer 3's deeper forensics: 18,380 of the 18,390 "wrong rows" are PADDING rows; TRM's genuine error rate on real rows of its own training split is 10/8,259 = 0.12% (it memorized the split), so a FIXED full-split miner yields ~O(500) real negatives, not ~12k — the real-error-dominant curriculum cannot be supplied as specified, and an alternative error source (early checkpoint / different seed / cross-fold) is a NEW design carrying the exact distribution-shift trap that killed v1. (2) CEILING — even with a perfect dataset, measured in-distribution mastery is 0.79 AUROC / 0.444 top-1 with ~36% synthetic→real transfer efficiency; the lineage's real-class ceiling across two architectures and two curricula is ~0.63-0.69, while matching vote's pass@2=0.4516 needs per-task AUROC ~0.92-0.99 (the vote-missed headroom tasks need 0.996-0.999: gold with 2 votes among 599 candidates; 1-cell diff among 754; a uniform 0.90 AUROC yields only pass@2≈0.29; headroom golds rank mid-pack by E: 186/599, 486/754; 4/5 headroom golds Pareto-dominated in (votes,E)). (3) SIGNAL CLASS — the only above-chance reading reviewer 1 cites (0.6038 on the <=5%-cell class) is the MINOR class (11-12% of wrong-pair mass); the dominant class — same-shape plausible-but-wrong rule applications, 59.1% of real errors / 81.4% of pairs — sits at 0.502 macro / 0.3283 pair-weighted, BELOW chance and REGRESSED from v1 (0.6283/0.4707), mechanistically because the near-miss curriculum teaches "gold+small defect=bad" while the curriculum's median changed-cell fraction is 0.083 vs the real pool's 0.40. Vote's 0.92-0.98 on that class is generator-marginal signal, not content signal — it proves the class is discriminable by SOME information source, not by a content energy. Reviewer 1's own caveat concedes "rule-level discrimination at 1.27M params remains a long shot." No quantified path to 0.92 exists; retirement stands.

GATE-1 BLIND SPOT (reviewer 2's decisive contribution): the gate is a self-licking ice cream cone — the v1 model ("predictably doomed") PASSES v2's synthetic gate at 0.7291 against the 0.70 bar, so the gate never discriminated v2 from v1; the artifact's "v1 measured 0.481 here" contrast is a category error (v1's REAL-pool near-miss AUROC vs the SYNTHETIC gate), and v2's own real-pool <=5%-cell AUROC is 0.58-0.60 (vs vote 0.95 on the same class). Gate-1 itself is honest as computed (fresh seeds 0.80-0.83; committed value the LOWEST of four) but measures curriculum-fitting, not transfer.

SEVERITY: major (4/5 reviewers) — attached entirely to the artifact's self-description, not its numbers: (a) mined_meta overstates the tested axis ~24-25x and its 59.9% wrong-rate is a ~500x padding artifact (a v3 planner reading it would mis-budget); (b) "GATE-1 PASSED" framing is materially misleading per the blind-spot finding; (c) selection_beats_random=true carries no significance caveat (P=0.468); (d) the dominant-class regression and the real-near-miss transfer AUROC (the decisive diagnostic) are unreported; (e) independence violation: mined from the SAME TRM checkpoint as the eval generator (panel spec'd different seed/early checkpoint) — in the direction that should HELP, and it still landed at random, which strengthens the negative.

DISPOSITION: retire the trained-content-energy lineage on this pool per the pre-registered condition; file the corrigendum on results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_transition_ebm.json before any ledger citation; append the honest bound + the rule-application-consistency gap to ops/verifier_gaps.md; add the lineage to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml. The remaining serious candidates are execution/program-synthesis verification (inducing and executing the candidate rule — synthesizing the missing negative class IS program synthesis) and vote-primary hybrids gated by executed-rule consistency. Key files: results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_transition_ebm.json, results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_ebm.pt, results/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_mined_negs.json.gz, scripts/experiments/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_mine_real_negs.py (bug at run_join: inv_fn(_crop(inputs[i])) yields empty grids feeding the slot key), ops/verifier_gaps.md.
